messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: DETECTED: Elevated 5xx rates for inference service in europe-west2 zone-b. Impacting model variants: redwood/opt-1.3b and community/llama-like-13b-quant. Aggregate error rate ~18% over 5m. Auto-retries failing for some clients. Pager escalation to #incidents sent.
Alex Chen: acked, I'm on it. telling oncall runbook step 1.
Priya Kumar: looking at the node pool in zone-b now. seeing lots of OOM/kernels errors in runtime logs. attaching snippet.
Priya Kumar: ```
2026-03-14T22:10:03Z runtime[serve-0]: kv_cache alloc failed: out of memory
2026-03-14T22:10:04Z runtime[serve-0]: failed to init attention kernel: cuLaunchKernel() err
```
Marco Garcia: hmm GPU mem pressure spike. can we confirm if a recent model rollout hit zone-b specifically? checking model routing table.
Marco Garcia: routing shows steady traffic to redwood/opt-1.3b in zone-b; there was a small canary earlier but no config changes in the last 2 hours.
Alex Chen: good. Priya, can we drain new requests from zone-b and route to zone-a and zone-c as short-term mitigation? need step-by-step.
Priya Kumar: initiating graceful drain for zone-b via runtime control plane: `./ctl drain --region europe-west2 --zone b --grace 30s`
ops-bot: Action queued: drain requested by Priya Kumar for europe-west2 zone-b. Estimated completion 00:00:30.
Dana (Support): heads-up: clients S-435, S-782, and S-OSR have active sessions hitting zone-b. I'll prepare outbound comms if impact persists >15m.
Jesse (Product): we should update the status page. suggested short status: "Degraded inference in europe-west2 (zone-b). Some requests may fail or retry. We are routing traffic to other zones and investigating."
ops-bot: Suggested status page update draft ready.
ops-bot: ```
Status: Degraded
Components: Inference - europe-west2 zone-b
Impact: Some requests to redwood/opt-1.3b and community/llama-like-13b-quant may fail or experience increased latency.
Mitigation: Traffic being routed to europe-west2 zones a/c and other regions as needed. Engineers are investigating memory/kernel failures.
ETA: TBC
```
Alex Chen: +1 publish that. Priya, once drain completes, can you confirm no queued requests and then set routing weight 0 for zone-b?
Priya Kumar: drain completed at 22:12:12 UTC. `kubectl get pods` shows pods not accepting new connections. Proceeding to update traffic weights.
Marco Garcia: updating routing policy now to remove zone-b from primary list and enable fallback models in region. commands: 
```
rtctl set-weight europe-west2 zone-b 0
rtctl set-weight europe-west2 zone-a 60
rtctl set-weight europe-west2 zone-c 40
```
Marco Garcia: weights applied. Monitoring for error reduction.
Alex Chen: monitor SLO dashboards and set temporary throttle for heavy clients if we see spikes.
Priya Kumar: after weight change 5xxs dropped to ~3% in 2m. kernel OOM logs continuing but less traffic.
Dana (Support): drafting customer notification for the affected customers. Proposed copy: "We're experiencing degraded inference in europe-west2 zone-b; we've rerouted traffic and mitigations are in progress. If you see increased latency or failures, please contact support@redwood.ai or reply here. We'll post updates on status.redwood.ai."
Jesse (Product): make it more specific: include affected model names and that dedicated customers may see session resync. add a link to the status page.
Dana (Support): updated notice: "Affected models: redwood/opt-1.3b, community/llama-like-13b-quant. Mitigation: traffic rerouted to other zones; session resync may be required for some dedicated connections. Status: Investigating. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1999001234"
Alex Chen: assign follow-up owner for overnight: @Sam Night you are next on-call in 15m; handing off once we have a stable mitigation.
Sam Night: saw the ping, happy to take over if it persists. I'll set up a watch at 22:30 UTC.
Marco Garcia: note: we've enabled model-variant fallback for redwood/opt-1.3b to run a lower-memory quantized variant in zone-a/c to reduce pressure. This may slightly change latency/quality.
Priya Kumar: running health checks across other regions to ensure no cascading OOMs. so far clear.
Alex Chen: status page published and customer pings sent. ops-bot posted incident URL.
ops-bot: Published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1999001234 - Degraded (europe-west2 zone-b)
Dana (Support): three customers have replied; two reported transient failures but recovered after 6 retries. S-782 requested priority notification — I escalated to account team.
Jesse (Product): flagging this for a post-incident review: potential causes to investigate: (1) regression in kernel allocator; (2) sudden workload shift from internal batch jobs; (3) buggy canary causing increased memory footprints.
Priya Kumar: collecting runtime logs and saving to internal bucket: gs://redwood-logs/incidents/1999001234/ for postmortem.
Alex Chen: if error rates remain <5% for next 30m, we'll keep zone-b out of primary rotation and do a controlled restart of runtime nodes during low traffic window.
Sam Night: taking handoff at 22:30 UTC. I'll keep monitoring and will update channel with any changes.
Alex Chen: thanks team, great coordination. leaving notes for postmortem: timeline, mitigation steps, customer impact, and next steps for kernel patch.
incident-bot: Incident timeline created and assigned: INC-1999001234. Postmortem template: https://internal.redwood.ai/pm-templates/incident.
Sam Night: confirmed, marking handoff complete. I'll update when I start the controlled restart. :white_check_mark:
